author: Ari Koslow
title: Zach Thornton recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Mets recalled LHP Zach Thornton from Triple-A Syracuse.
impact: Thornton is set for his second career start on Friday against the Phillies. He has posted a 4.25 ERA in Triple-A this season.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Konnor Griffin (forearm) to be activated from IL Friday
desc: Konnor Griffin will be activated from the injured list on Friday after dealing with a forearm strain.
impact: Griffin has been on the shelf since May 31st, but he will make his return to the big-league club for Pittsburgh's weekend set against the Reds. The 20-year-old is slashing .270/.327/.402 with four homers and 14 stolen bases in 51 games at the MLB level this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: MJ Melendez optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Mets optioned MJ Melendez to Triple-A Syracuse.
impact: Melendez will return to Triple-A with Tyrone Taylor activated from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyrone Taylor (hip) activated from IL
desc: The Mets activated Tyrone Taylor from the injured list.
impact: Tyrone makes his return from a month-long absence. MJ Melendez was optioned as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ali Sanchez activated from paternity list
desc: The Yankees activated C Ali Sánchez from the paternity list.
impact: Sanchez will return to his reserve role behind the plate.

author: Ari Koslow
title: David Sandlin recalled from Triple-A
desc: The White Sox recalled RHP David Sandlin from Triple-A Charlotte.
impact: Sandlin will get a spot start on Friday against the Royals.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Joe Rock optioned to Triple-A
desc: The White Sox optioned LHP Joe Rock to Triple-A Charlotte.
impact: Rock should get another opportunity later in the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zach McCambley recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Reds recalled RHP Zach McCambley from Triple-A Louisville.
impact: McCambley will be back in a middle-relief role in the Reds bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tony Santillan (oblique) placed on IL
desc: The Reds placed RHP Tony Santillan on the 15-day injured list.
impact: Santillan had taken over the closer role for the Reds in June. He will now be sidelined for at least the next few weeks.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kazuma Okamoto goes yard in loss to Rangers
desc: Kazuma Okamoto went 2-for-4 in loss to the Rangers with a home run, two runs scored, and two RBI.
impact: Okamoto continues a productive stretch at the plate, driving in runs in four of his last five contests. The rookie remains one of many streaky bats in the Blue Jays lineup for manager John Schneider, slashing .241 with 18 homers, 51 RBI, and 42 runs scored through 79 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kevin Gausman shelled early in loss to Rangers
desc: Kevin Gausman allowed six earned runs on 10 hits and two walks while striking out four over six innings in Thursday's 6-5 loss to the Rangers.
impact: Gausman has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing four earned runs or more in four of his last five starts. The right-hander has fought inconsistent command for much of the season, posting a 4.36 ERA and 1.19 WHIP with a 4-6 record and 8.8 K/9 ratio across 17 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Troy Melton cruises on mound in loss to Astros
desc: Troy Melton allowed one earned run on two hits while striking out six over six innings in Thursday's loss to the Astros.
impact: Melton has been steady on the mound since being called up, allowing two earned runs or less in five of his six trips to the mound. The right-hander has offered manager AJ Hinch another stable starting option in the Tigers rotation, posting a 2.39 ERA and 0.85 WHIP with a 4-1 record and 2.8 K/BB ratio through six starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Adam Macko recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Blue Jays recalled Adam Macko from Triple-A Buffalo.
impact: There should be a corresponding move announced before first pitch for Toronto on Friday.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Dillon Dingler goes deep in loss to Astros
desc: Dillon Dingler went 1-for-3 in a loss to the Astros with a solo home run and one walk.
impact: Dingler continues a productive stretch at the plate, driving in runs in 12 of his last 21 contests. The catcher remains one of the few impactful bats in a disappointing Tigers lineup, carrying an .879 OPS with 19 home runs, 57 RBI, and 42 runs scored across 74 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Henry Bolte racks up three hits in win over Giants
desc: Henry Bolte went 3-for-5 in a win over the Giants with one run scored.
impact: Bolte has caught fire at the plate, collecting hits in seven of his last eight contests. The outfielder remains one of the more reliable options in the Athletics lineup for manager Mark Kotsay, batting .320 with two home runs, 10 RBI, 12 runs scored, and nine stolen bases across 39 games.
